QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_25

question.text: A Cat III AIF with Rs. 200 crore commitments and 10% hurdle has NAV pre-incentives of Rs. 240 crore after Year 1. Incentive fee rate is 15%. Incentive fees?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Hurdle reference = 200 × 1.10 = 220 crore. Excess = 240 − 220 = 20 crore. Incentive = 15% × 20 = Rs. 3 crore. **The Trap:** Rs. 6 crore uses 30% rate; Rs. 36 crore uses 15% on entire NAV; Rs. 40 crore is total excess pre fee %. **Cross-Exam Context:** Mirrors the workbook's Example 2 methodology. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Show the comparison of 15% vs 20% incentive rates to clients — impact on net return is meaningful.
